select c.client_id as clientId, cl.client_name as clientName, cl.belong_sponsor_id as projectSponsor, user.user_name as projectSponsorName, cl.belong_dept_id as bizDept, org.name as bizDeptName from contract_base_info c left join client cl on cl.id = c.client_id left join bifrost_org org on org.id = cl.belong_dept_id left join bifrost_user user on user.id = cl.belong_sponsor_id where contract_status = 'START_RENT'
and c.client_id in
#{clientId}
group by clientId, clientName, projectSponsor, projectSponsorName, bizDept, bizDeptName

select a.id, a.contract_status as contractStatus, a.contract_code as contractCode, a.proj_name as projName, a.biz_type as bizType, a.apply_credit_amount as contractAmount, b.overdueDays, b.overdueRent, c.lateCharge, org.name as bizDeptName, user.user_name as projSponsorName from contract_base_info a left join (select contract_id as contractId, client_id as clientId, max(a.overdue_days) as overdueDays, sum(a.overdue_amount) as overdueRent from (select id, client_id, contract_id, phase, (if(isnull(plan_collection_amount), 0, plan_collection_amount) - if(isnull(collection_amount), 0, collection_amount)) as overdue_amount, if (ifnull(plan_collection_amount,0) > ifnull(collection_amount,0), TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,plan_collection_date, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S')), 0) as overdue_days from collection_base_info where ((ifnull(principal,0) > ifnull(collection_principal,0)) or (ifnull(interest,0) > ifnull(collection_interest,0))) and cash_flow_item = 'RENT' AND plan_collection_date < CURRENT_DATE) a group by contractId) b on b.contractId = a.id left join ( select contract_id, sum(ifnull(penalty_interest, 0)) - sum(ifnull(collection_penalty_interest, 0)) as lateCharge from collection_base_info group by contract_id ) as c on a.id = c.contract_id left join bifrost_org org on org.id = a.biz_dept_id left join bifrost_user user on user.id = a.proj_sponsor_user_id where a.client_id = #{clientId} and a.contract_status != 'INVALID';

select id, client_id as clientId, contract_id as contractId, contract_code as contractCode, phase, (if(isnull(plan_collection_amount),0,plan_collection_amount) -if(isnull(collection_amount),0,collection_amount)) as overdueAmount, if (ifnull(plan_collection_amount, 0) > ifnull(collection_amount, 0),TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,plan_collection_date,DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S')),0) as overdueDays from collection_base_info where 1=1 and cash_flow_item = 'RENT' and plan_collection_date < CURRENT_DATE and client_id = #{clientId}

select a.id, a.contract_code as contractCode, b.guarantor_ids as guarantorIds, b.guarantor_contract_code as guarantorContractCode, b.guarantor_type as guarantorType, c.lessee_names as lesseeNames, d.lateCharge, d.overdueAmount as overdueAmount, d.overdueDays as overdueDays, d.phases as phases from contract_base_info a left join contract_guarantor b on a.id = b.contract_id left join (select contract_id,group_concat(lessee_name) as lessee_names from contract_tenantry group by contract_id) c on c.contract_id = a.id left join (select contract_id as contractId, client_id as clientId, max(a.overdue_days) as overdueDays, sum(a.overdue_amount) as overdueAmount, sum(a.lateCharge) as lateCharge, group_concat(',',a.phase) as phases from ( select id, client_id, contract_id, if (ifnull(plan_collection_amount,0) > ifnull(collection_amount,0), phase, null) as phase, (if(isnull(plan_collection_amount), 0, plan_collection_amount) - if(isnull(collection_amount), 0, collection_amount)) as overdue_amount, (if(isnull(penalty_interest), 0, penalty_interest) - if(isnull(collection_penalty_interest), 0, collection_penalty_interest)) as lateCharge, if (ifnull(plan_collection_amount,0) > ifnull(collection_amount,0), TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,plan_collection_date, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S')), 0) as overdue_days from collection_base_info where write_off_status != 'WRITE_OFF_COMPLETED' and cash_flow_item = 'RENT' AND plan_collection_date < CURRENT_DATE ) a group by contractId) d on d.contractId = a.id where a.id in
#{item}

select b.id as clientId, b.client_name as clientName, a.overdueDays, a.overdueAmount from client b left join (select contract_id as contractId, client_id as clientId, max(a.overdue_days) as overdueDays, sum(a.overdue_amount) as overdueAmount from (select id, client_id, contract_id, (if(isnull(plan_collection_amount), 0, plan_collection_amount) - if(isnull(collection_amount), 0, collection_amount)) as overdue_amount, if (ifnull(plan_collection_amount,0) > ifnull(collection_amount,0), TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,plan_collection_date, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S')), 0) as overdue_days from collection_base_info where write_off_status != 'WRITE_OFF_COMPLETED' and cash_flow_item = 'RENT' AND plan_collection_date < CURRENT_DATE) a where client_id = #{clientId} group by client_id) a on b.id = clientId where b.id = #{clientId}

select a.id,a.contract_code from contract_base_info a right join (SELECT p.contract_id, 'guarantor' as role FROM contract_guarantor_lib p INNER JOIN (SELECT main_id AS contract_id, MAX(version) AS version FROM common_version t1 WHERE t1.module = 'CONTRACT' AND t1.version_type = 1 GROUP BY main_id) m ON p.contract_id = m.contract_id AND p.version = m.version where guarantor_ids like concat('%',#{clientId},'%') union all SELECT p.contract_id,'lessee' as role FROM contract_tenantry_lib p INNER JOIN (SELECT main_id AS contract_id, MAX(version) AS version FROM common_version t1 WHERE t1.module = 'CONTRACT' AND t1.version_type = 1 GROUP BY main_id) m ON p.contract_id = m.contract_id AND p.version = m.version where lessee_id = #{clientId}) b on a.id = b.contract_id;

select * from contract_base_info cbi where cbi.contract_status in ('TAKE_EFFECT', 'START_RENT') and cbi.id not in (select contract_id from (SELECT contract_id, MAX(is_pledge) AS is_pledge, -- 取每组is_pledge的最大值 MAX(is_supervise) AS is_supervise from (select * from (SELECT contract_id, MAX(is_pledge) AS is_pledge, -- 取每组is_pledge的最大值 MAX(is_supervise) AS is_supervise -- 取每组is_supervise的最大值 FROM fund_direct_financing_pledge_info fdfpi JOIN fund_direct_financing_base_info ffbi ON fdfpi.financing_id = ffbi.id WHERE financing_status IN ('NEW', 'EFFECT', 'CARRY_INTEREST') GROUP BY contract_id -- 按contract_id分组 ) a union all select * from (SELECT contract_id, MAX(is_pledge) AS is_pledge, -- 取每组is_pledge的最大值 MAX(is_supervise) AS is_supervise -- 取每组is_supervise的最大值 FROM fund_financing_pledge_info fdfpi JOIN fund_financing_base_info ffbi ON fdfpi.financing_id = ffbi.id WHERE financing_status IN ('NEW', 'EFFECT', 'CARRY_INTEREST') GROUP BY contract_id -- 按contract_id分组 ) b) pledge GROUP BY contract_id) result where result.is_pledge = 1 and result.is_supervise = 1) and contract_code like concat('%', #{contractCode},'%')
